page_title.en: Numbers Court — Is the Equation Fair? (Grade 1)

page_intro.en: A free interactive Grade 1 math game for the meaning of the equal sign: be the Judge in Numbers Court and rule each math claim TRUE or FALSE on a balance beam where “=” means both sides hold the same amount — not “the answer comes next” — then prove it, and sometimes make it fair. Reading the equal sign relationally is the heart of Common Core 1.OA.D.7.
page_intro.de: Was bedeutet das Gleichheitszeichen? Mit Richterin Tess prüfen Kinder auf der Waage, ob Gleichungen stimmen. Kostenloses, interaktives Mathe-Spiel für Klasse 1.
